DDL.statement: ALTER TABLE SYS_RF_MENU ADD (MENU_ID VARCHAR2(35) DEFAULT 'root' NOT NULL)
UPDATE SYS_RF_MENU SET MENU_ID = 'root' WHERE MENU_ID IS NULL
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX RF_MENU_PK ON SYS_RF_MENU (MODULE_ID, MENU_ID)
UPDATE SYS_MODULES SET RF_ACTIVE = 'Y' WHERE MODULE_ID = 'MENU_QM'

INSERT INTO SYS_RF_MENU (MODULE_ID, MENU_ID, SEQUENCE_ID) SELECT 'MENU_QM', 'root', COALESCE((SELECT MAX(SEQUENCE_ID) FROM SYS_RF_MENU WHERE MODULE_ID = 'FRM_QM_PANEL' AND MENU_ID = 'root'), 103) FROM SYS_MODULES WHERE MODULE_ID = 'SYS_INFO' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM SYS_RF_MENU WHERE MODULE_ID = 'MENU_QM' AND MENU_ID = 'root')

INSERT INTO SYS_RF_MENU (MODULE_ID, MENU_ID, SEQUENCE_ID) SELECT 'FRM_QM_PANEL_SCORES', 'MENU_QM', 0 FROM SYS_MODULES WHERE MODULE_ID = 'SYS_INFO' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM SYS_RF_MENU WHERE MODULE_ID = 'FRM_QM_PANEL_SCORES' AND MENU_ID = 'MENU_QM')

INSERT INTO SYS_RF_MENU (MODULE_ID, MENU_ID, SEQUENCE_ID) SELECT 'FRM_QM_PANEL_SETUP', 'MENU_QM', 1 FROM SYS_MODULES WHERE MODULE_ID = 'SYS_INFO' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM SYS_RF_MENU WHERE MODULE_ID = 'FRM_QM_PANEL_SETUP' AND MENU_ID = 'MENU_QM')

INSERT INTO SYS_RF_MENU (MODULE_ID, MENU_ID, SEQUENCE_ID) SELECT 'FRM_QM_PANEL_ADMIN', 'MENU_QM', 2 FROM SYS_MODULES WHERE MODULE_ID = 'SYS_INFO' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM SYS_RF_MENU WHERE MODULE_ID = 'FRM_QM_PANEL_ADMIN' AND MENU_ID = 'MENU_QM')

INSERT INTO SYS_GROUP_PERMISSIONS (GROUP_ID, MODULE_ID) SELECT 'ADMIN', 'MENU_QM' FROM SYS_MODULES WHERE MODULE_ID = 'SYS_INFO' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM SYS_GROUP_PERMISSIONS WHERE GROUP_ID = 'ADMIN' AND MODULE_ID = 'MENU_QM')
DELETE FROM SYS_MENUS WHERE MODULE_ID = 'FRM_QM_PANEL' OR MENU_ID = 'FRM_QM_PANEL'
